correctness.rationale: The projective-normal incidence equations are a regular section of the direct sum of six normal-line dual bundles by Olberding--Walker Lemma 3.1; the ambient product is oriented. Whitney and equivariant determinant exact sequences imply w1(TB)=sum of six descended tautological first classes because the similarity group is connected and preserves Lie-algebra orientation. Six collision loops lie entirely in the quadrangle locus and pair with the six normal-line classes by the exact identity matrix (one Möbius and five trivial bundles on each). Thus independence, nonzero w1 and \(b_1\ge6\) hold globally. No finite checks are mistaken for proofs.

value.rationale: The newly studied four-dimensional quadrangle-moduli manifold is a natural geometric object, whose orientation local system and low-degree cohomology are needed for global topology and integration. The theorem gives an exact six-dimensional distinguished H1 subspace with geometrically dual degeneration loops, and identifies the precise nontrivial orientation obstruction. This is more than a one-off negative test or a routine numerical example; it is global structure not determined by the source smoothness theorem. It does not claim full Betti numbers.
